omittedDetails.description: Some details exceeded the delivery size budget.

occurredAt.description: ISO 8601 event time, independent of delivery time.

reply.description: Worker reply Markdown captured for this report.

preview.description: Optional display content for this label, shared by live and historical questions.

answerNotes.description: Optional notes keyed by question ID. The host obtains selected preview content from its pending question.

expectedVersion.description: Opaque version from the current reader's state.

seenResultId.description: Latest result in that version, or null if there is no result.

mark.description: Explicit mark when the host advertises readStateMarkVersion 1. Omit for automatic acknowledgement.
